title: Why Ukraine Hit Russia in Libya

scenes.text: But why were Russian warships there in the first place?
Before dawn on November twenty-second, naval drones struck Benghazi.
Kyiv says seven boats launched from a mothership, wrecking the corvette Merkury and hitting the cargo ship Angara.
Kyiv links Angara to military supply routes through Syria and Libya.
Libya gives Russia access to operations deeper inside Africa.
Tartus still matters too. Russia kept resupplying its Syrian facilities.
But the strike had consequences: two Libyan naval officers later died, according to eastern forces.
Reuters says a Russian convoy heading for Libya turned back.
Does hitting these routes weaken Russia, or spread the war?
